steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Athenian democracy developed in stages: Solon's reforms (594 BC) cancelled debts and banned debt slavery; Cleisthenes (508 BC) reorganised citizens into demes and tribes; Pericles (460s BC) introduced pay for office holders

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The ecclesia (assembly) was the sovereign decision-making body: all male citizens could speak and vote on laws, war, treaties and ostracism

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The boule (council of 500) set the agenda for the assembly and oversaw day-to-day administration; members were chosen by lot from the ten tribes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ostracism allowed citizens to exile one person for 10 years by majority vote, removing potential tyrants

steps.title: Try it yourself
